correctness.rationale: For independent l,m the differential of l^(d-1)m yields E=l^(d-2)(lV+mV), dimension 2n+1 from one exterior-square kernel. The common polynomial factor of all elements is l^(d-2) (dim V>=3); dividing recovers the quadratic space L2 V, whose saturated ideal recovers L2, establishing injectivity on flags. Equivariance identifies stabilizer and the smooth closed flag orbit. The determinant of L1^(d-2) tensor ((L2 tensor V)/wedge^2 L2) gives Plucker weight (a+n,n). Borel-Weil/Weyl dimensions give the entire Hilbert function and Cartan multiplication plus highest-weight orbit normality gives projective normality in characteristic zero. Independently checked leading finite difference equals the intersection-theoretic degree for 25 (n,d) pairs (n=2..6,d=3..7). Finite checks corroborate but do not establish the scheme-theoretic argument.

value.rationale: The natural ordinary Gauss map of a singular tangential Veronese has a canonical Grassmannian degree. Identifying its compactified smooth flag model and actual, rather than chosen, Plucker polarization and full Hilbert function for every n,d gives usable enumerative and representation-theoretic invariants. This is not a mere higher Gauss degree of the smooth Veronese; standard highest-weight methods are tools, not the novelty itself.
